title: Bias of a random empirical density
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $0<\varepsilon<1$. Draw $\lceil 8n/\varepsilon^2\rceil$ independent uniform points from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$, and form their empirical probability density relative to the uniform distribution on that cube. The probability that this density has some nonzero Fourier coefficient of absolute value greater than $\varepsilon$ is at most $2^{-n}$.
